name: ChronoWeave Engine
readiness_note: Original proposed tasks and oracle ideas, never measured trial evidence. Public behavior contracts, reference implementations and per-step external acceptance checks are not complete; benchmark execution is unavailable. Architectural pressures are unverified hypotheses, not required source layout. Pressure commentary is adapted to neutral, testable risks without predicting outcomes for any arm.
source: Google prototype src/engine/evalsBenchmark.ts: public titles and prompts preserved; architectural-pressure commentary adapted; synthetic outcomes and diagnoses excluded.

steps.title: Design Bitemporal Causal Quarantine Engine (Seed Architecture)
steps.prompt: Design and implement ChronoWeave: an in-memory and SQLite-backed bitemporal ledger where every assertion carries (effective_at, asserted_at, causal_parents). Support speculative branch forking, retroactive tombstone retraction, and deterministic state materialization at any (effective_t, assertion_t) coordinate.
steps.architectural_pressure: Coupling bitemporal index storage directly to speculative branch state makes later retroactive clawbacks and seal verifiers require full-table rewrites.

steps.title: Retroactive Tombstone Cascade & Taint Propagation
steps.prompt: When an assertion is retracted at assertion_t2 for an earlier effective_t1, automatically mark all causally dependent downstream assertions as tainted_pending_reconcile unless insulated by a checkpoint.
steps.architectural_pressure: Mutating node taint flags inside materializer.py during read queries violates read/write separation and breaks repeatable historical reads.

steps.title: Epoch Seal Witnesses (Immutable Horizon Locks)
steps.prompt: Add cryptographic epoch seals that freeze effective_t intervals against retroactive assertions unless accompanied by an OverrideAuthority proof.
steps.architectural_pressure: Hardcoding seal verification inside timeline_store.append() couples storage to authority policy.

steps.title: Counterfactual Branch Diffing & Three-Way Causal Merge
steps.prompt: Allow forking a speculative branch from any historical (effective_t, assertion_t) coordinate, applying hypothetical assertions, and computing a minimal causal diff against main.
steps.architectural_pressure: Deep-copying the entire SQLite/in-memory store per speculative branch explodes memory and latency on nested forks.

steps.title: Non-Monotonic Grant Inversion Rules
steps.prompt: Support non-monotonic derived rules where a late-arriving negative assertion inverts a previously derived capability grant and emits a CompensationObligation record.
steps.architectural_pressure: Embedding rule evaluation inside the storage cursor creates a 3-module dependency cycle between store, rules, and obligations.

steps.title: Declared Component CI Policy & Fast Verification Path
steps.prompt: Configure deterministic test target selection so edits to a single rule or verifier run only its component and contract tests in <1s.
steps.architectural_pressure: Without declared input-to-target mappings, every small rule change runs the full bitemporal replay suite.

steps.title: Pluggable Conflict Resolver Family (3 Initial Strategies)
steps.prompt: Add three concurrent branch merge conflict resolvers: LastAssertionWins, CausalDepthPriority, and QuorumWitnessResolver.
steps.architectural_pressure: Using a central if/elif registry in merge.py forces every future resolver request to edit merge.py and re-run all merge suites.

steps.title: Fault Probe P1: Retroactive Clock-Skew Tie-Breaker Shift
steps.prompt: PROBE P1: Two assertions arriving with identical effective_t and asserted_at timestamps from different nodes must now break ties by deterministic BLAKE2b payload digest rather than insertion order.
steps.architectural_pressure: If tie-breaking was duplicated across materializer, diff engine, and conflict resolvers, changing it causes subtle divergence across 6+ files.

steps.title: Tenant-Isolated Bitemporal Namespaces & Quota Budgets
steps.prompt: Isolate assertions, speculative branches, and epoch seals by tenant_id with configurable per-tenant active branch and assertion byte budgets.
steps.architectural_pressure: Threading tenant_id manually through 30 helper functions instead of scoping at the session/envelope boundary.

steps.title: Four Additional Domain Verifiers (Escrow, Compliance, GeoFence, RateCap)
steps.prompt: Add four independent assertion pre-commit verifiers: EscrowHoldVerifier, GDPRRetentionVerifier, GeoFenceJurisdictionVerifier, and BurstRateCapVerifier.
steps.architectural_pressure: Central registrar edits and shared mutable verifier config dictionaries cause cross-verifier test interference.

steps.title: Portable Audit Bundle Export & Deterministic Replay Verification
steps.prompt: Export a canonical, zstd-compressed JSON audit bundle of any bitemporal slice that another node can import and verify without trusting local indexes.
steps.architectural_pressure: Serializing internal cache dictionaries or SQLite row IDs into the portable bundle breaks cross-node import.

steps.title: Retroactive Fee & Royalty Clawback Calculator
steps.prompt: Compute net financial adjustments when a historical grant assertion is retracted 30 days later, accounting for tiered volume brackets.
steps.architectural_pressure: Mixing decimal fee arithmetic directly into causal_graph traversal nodes.

steps.title: Streaming Horizon Compaction & Cold-Slice Archival
steps.prompt: Compact sealed bitemporal horizons older than a retention watermark into read-only summary checkpoints while preserving causal provenance hashes.
steps.architectural_pressure: Compaction deleting parent nodes that unsealed speculative branches still reference.

steps.title: Webhook & Event Sink Transports with Idempotency Keys
steps.prompt: Emit deterministic outbound notifications whenever a speculative branch is promoted or a retroactive taint invalidates a sealed grant.
steps.architectural_pressure: Performing synchronous network/webhook I/O inside the transaction commit lock.

steps.title: Fault Probe P2: Poisoned Speculative Merge & Partial Rollback
steps.prompt: PROBE P2: If a promoted speculative branch contains an assertion whose verifier depends on a concurrently retracted parent in main, abort promotion atomically and record a QuarantineReceipt.
steps.architectural_pressure: Partial promotion leaves main with half-applied assertions if verifiers run after state mutation.

steps.title: Declarative Query DSL for Bitemporal Lineage Predicates
steps.prompt: Add a compact query mini-language (e.g. `EFFECTIVE BETWEEN t1 AND t2 WHERE TAINTED BY author:x`) parsed into safe predicate ASTs.
steps.architectural_pressure: Using Python eval() or coupling the parser directly to SQLite SQL string interpolation.

steps.title: Circuit Breaker & Degraded Read-Only Mode for External Authority Oracles
steps.prompt: Wrap remote authority witness verification in a circuit breaker that falls back to cached quorum certificates during network partitions.
steps.architectural_pressure: Global circuit-breaker state shared across tenants causes one noisy tenant to trip degraded mode for all tenants.

steps.title: Five Regional Compliance Policy Plugins (EU, US-CA, JP, BR, SG)
steps.prompt: Add five regional data-residency and right-to-erasure bitemporal policy plugins with zero changes to existing verifiers or core engine.
steps.architectural_pressure: If Step 9 did not establish an open plugin discovery contract, adding 5 regional plugins touches 8+ core files.

steps.title: Zero-Knowledge Redaction Views (Role-Scoped Provenance Masking)
steps.prompt: Allow auditors without payload clearance to verify causal graph integrity and timestamp monotonicity using blinded commitment hashes.
steps.architectural_pressure: Mutating nodes in-place during redaction or leaking raw assertion payloads through error tracebacks.

steps.title: MCP & HTTP JSON-RPC Transport Parity for ChronoWeave
steps.prompt: Expose all ChronoWeave inspection, branch simulation, and audit export operations identically over CLI, MCP stdio, and HTTP.
steps.architectural_pressure: Duplicating validation and business logic inside HTTP route handlers and CLI subcommands.

steps.title: Fault Probe P3: Cross-Epoch Diamond Causal Cycle & Compaction Race
steps.prompt: PROBE P3: Handle a diamond causal graph where two speculative branches merge across a compacted horizon boundary while a retroactive retraction arrives on the shared ancestor.
steps.architectural_pressure: Spaghetti interaction between compaction (Step 12), branch merge (Step 6), and taint cascade (Step 1) causes infinite recursion or silent data loss.

oracle_ideas: INV-CW-01: Historical queries at (effective_t, assertion_t) must be 100% repeatable even after later retractions or compactions.
INV-CW-02: Adding a new Verifier or ConflictResolver plugin must require 0 edits to core timeline_store.py or merge.py registrars.
INV-CW-03: Speculative branch promotion must be atomic; concurrent parent retraction aborts promotion and emits a QuarantineReceipt.
